item.title: Sir Martin Sorrell with David Buik and Michael Wilson
item.summary: The UK Investor Magazine was thrilled to welcome Sir Martin Sorrell to the podcast for a broad-ranging conversation covering FIFA’s failed attempt to raise private investment, the current state of the UK economy, and where he sees opportunities by geography. Having been in the US for the World Cup, S4 Capital Chairman Sir Martin starts […] The post Sir Martin Sorrell with David Buik and Michael Wilson appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
